title: SpyKids Mission Training Become a Top Secret Spy
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Unlock the secrets of espionage with SpyKids Mission Training, designed for ages 12 and under. Guided through Georgetown, your young spy will delve into the world of espionage, learning how spies communicate, decode messages, and craft concealment devices. This interactive experience teaches them about real spies and their ingenious methods, including the intriguing tale of how bananas played a role in a government overthrow. Can your child complete their mission without being caught by spy hunters. 

- Engaging spy-themed adventure for kids aged 12 and under
- Learn spy skills like decoding messages and creating concealment devices
- Explore the historic Georgetown area and its espionage history
- Fun and educational experience with expert guidance
